notes.title: Update Patch 1.0.12
notes.content:
First patch to fix the issues I'm aware of :

-Added colliders to limit falling off bounds
-Added fallbox that should have been there since the start
-Added some puzzle clarity


If I see other important or game-breaking issues I will try to patch them quickly. 

I wanted to take this opportunity to thank everyone who played this game. While writing this message, there's almost 12 000 people who added the game to their library. Thanks to everyone who left a review, the good ones for encouragement and the negative ones to know what to improve.
